title: Google Sheet to Supabase one-way sync Edge Function (cron)
description: Implement the custom cron sync that pulls data from the Google Sheet (Leads, Propiedades, Conversaciones, Anuncios, Asesores, NocNok raw tabs) into Supabase every 1-2 minutes. This is a new Supabase Edge Function at supabase/functions/sheet_sync/. Key invariants: (1) NEVER overwrite lead.stage once stage >= S6 (stage-ownership frontier guard); (2) NEVER touch advisor-only columns: notas, visitas, motivo_descarte, handoff_trigger on the lead; (3) NEVER sync in the Supabase->Sheet direction; (4) Upsert semantics keyed on the Sheet's own 'id' column for leads/propiedades; (5) Conversaciones are append-only (insert new rows, never update/delete); (6) Asesores upsert by email/id matched to sales table; (7) NocNok raw is a full-replace upsert. The function reads GOOGLE_SHEET_ID and GOOGLE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_KEY from environment secrets. It uses the Supabase service-role key to bypass RLS for bulk writes.
acceptance_criteria: supabase/functions/sheet_sync/index.ts implements an HTTP-triggered (cron-compatible) Edge Function that fetches all six Sheet tabs and upserts into Supabase tables: contacts (leads), propiedades, conversaciones, anuncios, sales (asesores), nocnok_raw

The sync function contains an explicit stage-ownership frontier guard: before upserting a lead row, if the existing lead.stage >= 'S6' (or = 'descartado'), the stage column is excluded from the upsert payload
The sync function never writes to these columns regardless of Sheet data: motivo_descarte, handoff_trigger (and notes/visitas which are in separate tables)
Conversaciones rows are INSERT-only (no UPDATE on existing rows); duplicate detection uses (lead_id, timestamp, rol) composite key
supabase/functions/sheet_sync/sheet_sync.test.ts includes unit tests for: stage-ownership frontier guard, advisor-field exclusion, and conversacion deduplication logic
The function handles Google Sheets API rate limits with exponential backoff (max 3 retries)
Error responses return structured JSON with sheet_tab, row_count, error_count, and a sample of failed rows
supabase/functions/sheet_sync/README.md documents the required environment variables (GOOGLE_SHEET_ID, GOOGLE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_KEY) and the cron scheduling approach

non_functional_requirements.performance: Full sync of all 6 tabs completes in <60s; partial failures on one tab do not abort others
non_functional_requirements.security: Service-role key used only inside the Edge Function — never exposed to frontend; Sheet API key stored as Supabase secret
non_functional_requirements.scalability: Handles up to 5,000 lead rows and 50,000 conversacion rows per sync cycle without timeout
